avm: $1.5m — comparable-sales estimate, cross-checked vs the state government sales register
reasoning: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE ONLY — a fictional property and fictional sales, to show the report layout. In a real run every figure comes from sales you supply or genuinely look up. This skill never invents a sale.

The direct-comparison read brackets the subject between a weaker nearby sale (the floor) and a superior renovated home (the ceiling), then cross-checks a land rate. The subject sits toward the middle: renovated, but on a smaller block than the top comps.
Land-rate check: $1.5m ÷ 600 m² = $2,500/m², in line with the closest comparables. The reads converge near $1.5m.
confidence_note: To sharpen: confirm interior condition and any recent renovation, verify living area, and check council overlays.
comps_note: Illustrative example — fictional property and sales, for layout only. In a real run, sale prices anchor on the state government land-titles register (the Valuer-General); photos are optional and user-supplied (only images you have the right to use).
